body: The grass beneath my toes was damp with morning dew, each step sinking deeper into the soft soil. I felt a strange warmth spread through me as curiosity outweighed caution. The faint smell of earth mingled with something familiar—perhaps a hint of decay or rotting leaves? As I tentatively stepped forward, the prints stretched out before me like an invitation. My heart raced slightly, but not enough to stop me.
